tei:div.tei:p: sgrol dkar mchod phreng cung zad rgyas par spro na/ oṃ: dngos 'byor yid kyis rnam sprul pa'i: zhing khams rgya mtsho'i mchod yon kun: 'phags ma yid bzhin 'khor lor 'bul: bzhes nas 'chi med dngos grub stsol: oṃ ār+ya tā ra sa pa ri bā ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā: oṃ: dngos 'byor yid kyis rnam sprul pa'i: zhing khams rgya mtsho'i zhal bsil kun: 'phags ma yid bzhin 'khor lor 'bul: bzhes nas 'chi med dngos grub stsol: oṃ ār+ya tā ra sa pa ri bā ra pā d+yaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā: oṃ: dngos 'byor yid kyis rnam sprul pa'i: zhing khams rgya mtsho'i me tog kun: 'phags ma yid bzhin 'khor lor 'bul: bzhes nas 'chi med dngos grub stsol: oṃ ār+ya tā ra sa pa ri bā ra puṣ+pe pra tīts+tsha swā hā: oṃ: dngos 'byor yid kyis rnam sprul pa'i: zhing khams rgya mtsho'i bdug spos kun: 'phags ma yid bzhin 'khor lor 'bul: bzhes nas 'chi med dngos grub stsol: oṃ ār+ya tā ra sa pa ri bā ra dhū pe pra tīts+tsha swā hā: oṃ: dngos 'byor yid kyis rnam sprul pa'i: zhing khams rgya mtsho'i snang gsal kun: 'phags ma yid bzhin 'khor lor 'bul: bzhes nas 'chi med dngos grub stsol: oṃ ār+ya tā ra sa pa ri bā ra ā lo ke pra tīts+tsha swā hā: oṃ: dngos 'byor yid kyis rnam sprul pa'i: zhing khams rgya mtsho'i dri chab kun: 'phags ma yid bzhin 'khor lor 'bul: bzhes nas 'chi med dngos grub stsol: oṃ ār+ya tā ra sa pa ri bā ra gan+dhe pra tīts+tsha swā hā: oṃ: dngos 'byor yid kyis rnam sprul pa'i: zhing khams rgya mtsho'i zhal zas kun: 'phags ma yid bzhin 'khor lor 'bul: bzhes nas 'chi med dngos grub stsol: oṃ ār+ya tā ra sa pa ri bā ra nai bid+ya pra tīts+tsha swā hā: oṃ: dngos 'byor yid kyis rnam sprul pa'i: zhing khams rgya mtsho'i rol mo kun: 'phags ma yid bzhin 'khor lor 'bul:

bzhes nas 'chi med dngos grub stsol: oṃ ār+ya tā ra sa pa ri bā ra shab+da pra tīts+tsha swā hā: zhes dang*/ oṃ: yul dang dbang por 'brel ba yi: gzung 'dzin bde ba chen por shar: rdo rje gzugs kyi longs spyod mchog: mchod pa'i phyag rgya chen por bzhengs: oṃ ār+ya tā ra sa pa ri bā ra rū pa pra tīts+tsha swā hā: oṃ: yul dang dbang por 'brel ba yi: gzung 'dzin bde ba chen por shar: rdo rje sgra yi longs spyod mchog: mchod pa'i phyag rgya chen por bzhengs: oṃ ār+ya tā ra sa pa ri bā ra shab+da pra tīts+tsha swā hā: oṃ: yul dang dbang por 'brel ba yi: gzung 'dzin bde ba chen por shar: rdo rje dri yi longs spyod mchog: mchod pa'i phyag rgya chen por bzhengs: oṃ ār+ya tā ra sa pa ri bā ra gan+dhe pra tīts+tsha swā hā: oṃ: yul dang dbang por 'brel ba yi: gzung 'dzin bde ba chen por shar: rdo rje ro yi longs spyod mchog: mchod pa'i phyag rgya chen por bzhengs: oṃ ār+ya tā ra sa pa ri bā ra ra sa pra tīts+tsha swā hā: oṃ: yul dang dbang por 'brel ba yi: gzung 'dzin bde ba chen por shar: rdo rje reg bya'i longs spyod mchog: mchod pa'i phyag rgya chen por bzhengs: oṃ ār+ya tā ra sa pa ri bā ra spar+she pra tīts+tsha swā hā: zhes dang*/ oṃ: rtsa brgyad stong sbyar a mṛ ta: 'chi med bdud rtsi g.yung drung chu: dug lnga sel ba'i sman chen pos: dkyil 'khor lha tshogs mnyes gyur cig: sarba pañca a mṛta khā hi: 'dir brgyud pa'i mtshan don sbyar/ ༈ tshe dpag med mgon gtsug tor rnam rgyal ma// yid bzhin 'khor lo rig 'dzin shrī siṃ ha// dri med bshes gnyen mtsho skyes rdo rje la// sman mchod 'bul lo tshe dbang dngos grub stsol// sarba pañca a mṛta khā hi/ mnga' bdag yab sras bai ro rgyal mchog dbyangs// gnubs chen nam snying ye shes mtsho rgyal ma// rang byung rdo rje'i gzi brjid rtsal 'chang la// sman mchod 'bul lo tshe dbang dngos grub stsol// sarba pañca a mṛta khā hi/

rigs bzhi'i sgrol ma phrin las lha mo bzhi// tshe dbang rig 'dzin chos srung gter gyi bdag /snang srid 'chi med 'khor lor dag pa la// sman mchod 'bul lo tshe dbang dngos grub stsol// sarba pañca a mṛta khā hi/ zhes bdud rtsi'i thigs gtor phul pa'i lhag ma dngos grub kyi dbyig tu bltas la/ badz+ra a mṛta sid+dhi sa ma ya hoḥ zhes lcer myang ngo*// 'di'ang blo gros mtha' yas pa'i sdes zhabs tog tu spel ba'o//) hrī: pad+ma bhañja'i snod nang du: khams gsum bsgral pa'i rak+ta'i bcud: bde mchog bde ba'i rol mo yis: dkyil 'khor lha tshogs mnyes gyur cig: ma hā rak+ta khā hi: hūm̐: stong gsum 'jig rten snod yangs par: khams gsum 'gro kun gtor mar sbyar: 'dod yon lnga ldan ba liṃ tas: dkyil 'khor lha tshogs mnyes gyur cig: ma hā ba liṃ ta khā hi: zhes sbyar/ de nas don mchod la 'jug go /ces pa'ang rje bla ma'i rdo rje'i gsung ma bslad par pad+ma gar dbang gis bris pa dge legs 'phel/// /
